newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon fishing port blocked by protest.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon fishing port blocked by protest.

text.p: Trawlers paralysed Lisbon's fishing port on Thursday in a protest against a state decree banning fishing in the open seas for a 24-hour period on weekends, a shipowners' spokesman said.
"Docapesca port in Alges has been paralysed since 0800 (0700 GMT) this morning," Pedro Franca, president of the Association of Fishing Industry Shipowners, told Reuters.
"About 100 fishing boats are blocking the entry and exit of vessels at the port."

He said the decree banning fishing by Portuguese ships beyond 19 kilometres (12 miles) from the coast for a 24-hour period on weekends was discriminatory as the Spanish fishing industry faced no such restrictions.
Franca said he expected the protest to spread to other Portuguese ports on Thursday.
